response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills, staff-level titles, and recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic-workflow tooling, which maps directly to the role's key technologies. However, the role requires 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions, and his AI experience appears limited to roughly the past year; there is no demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, AI data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI. His teaching, workshop, and consulting background suggests customer-facing potential, but the core GenAI depth gap makes him a stretch for a Staff Forward Deployed GenAI role.
strengths: Recent hands-on work on MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure
15+ years of production software experience across web, backend, and high-scale distributed systems
Proven mentorship and communication skills via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: Falls far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1 year of AI-adjacent work)
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks
Limited demonstrated cloud AI system design; cloud experience appears limited to AWS CDK for pricing services

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering seniority and mentorship track record
